entity.name: Chennai Central Warrenville
entity.subtitle: Indian Restaurant & Banquet
entity.description: Authentic South Indian Cuisine in Warrenville, IL. Dum Biryani, Masala Dosa, Chettinad specialties, and fine South Indian dining.

categories.name: Biryani
categories.description: Discover Chennai Central's biryani specialties, including Seeragasamba Chicken Biryani, Thalapakatti Goat Biryani, and Chennai Street Style Bhai Chicken Biryani, slow-cooked with aromatic spices.

categories.name: Dosa Corner
categories.description: Traditional crispy and savory South Indian dosas including classic masala, ghee roast, and specialty fillings.

categories.name: Tiffin
categories.description: Classic South Indian breakfast and tiffin favorites including soft idly, crispy vada, and comforting accompaniments.

categories.name: Veg Starter
categories.description: Crisp and flavorful vegetarian appetizers featuring spiced fritters, samosas, and classic snack specialties.

categories.name: Non-Veg Starter
categories.description: Fiery and aromatic non-vegetarian appetizers featuring Chicken 65, pepper chicken, and seafood starters.

categories.name: Tandoori
categories.description: Clay oven roasted meats and paneer infused with smoky aromatics, yogurt marinades, and Indian spices.

categories.name: Chaat
categories.description: Zesty and vibrant street food chaats balancing tangy, sweet, and spicy flavors.

categories.name: Veg Entree
categories.description: Rich vegetarian gravies and homestyle curries including paneer specialties, lentil daals, and vegetable korma.

categories.name: Non- Veg Entree
categories.description: Signature South Indian chicken, goat, fish, and seafood curries simmered in Chettinad and traditional gravies.

categories.name: CC Paratha corner
categories.description: Layered parottas, flavorful salna pairings, and Chennai-style kothu and kizhi paratha preparations.

categories.name: Breads
categories.description: Freshly baked tandoori naans, rotis, parottas, and traditional griddle breads.

categories.name: Weekday Thali Special
categories.description: Complete traditional platters featuring rice, curries, sides, and accompaniments.

categories.name: Indo-Chinese
categories.description: Savory fried rice, wok-tossed noodles, and Schezwan favorites with vibrant Indo-Chinese flair.

categories.name: Variety Rice
categories.description: Comforting South Indian seasoned rice specialties including bisibelebath, curd rice, and lemon rice.

categories.name: Soup
categories.description: Warming broths and traditional rasams infused with black pepper, garlic, and aromatic herbs.

categories.name: Kids Menu
categories.description: Kid-friendly portions including noodles, mild dosas, and chocolate dosas.

categories.name: Desserts
categories.description: Traditional South Indian and classic Indian sweets including gulab jamun, rasmalai, and halwa.

categories.name: Drinks
categories.description: Authentic beverages including Madras filter coffee, masala chai, mango lassi, and regional refreshments.

signatureDishes.name: Chennai Street Style Bhai Chicken Biryani
signatureDishes.description: Aromatic, long-grain biryani inspired by Chennai's beloved bhai-style biryani, layered with tender chicken, fragrant spices and beautifully seasoned rice.

signatureDishes.name: Masala Dosa
signatureDishes.description: A crisp, golden South Indian dosa filled with warmly spiced potato masala, served with traditional chutneys and sambar.

signatureDishes.name: Ghee Roast Dosa
signatureDishes.description: A paper-thin dosa roasted in ghee until deeply golden and crisp, paired with classic South Indian chutneys and sambar.

signatureDishes.name: Chicken Tikka
signatureDishes.description: Tender pieces of chicken marinated in aromatic spices and yogurt, grilled until beautifully charred and full of flavor.

signatureDishes.name: Gulab Jamun
signatureDishes.description: Soft, golden milk dumplings soaked in fragrant sugar syrup, offering a warm and delicate finish to the meal.

signatureDishes.name: Paneer Tikka
signatureDishes.description: Juicy paneer marinated with Indian spices and yogurt, grilled with peppers and onions for a smoky, satisfying bite.

signatureDishes.name: Rasmalai
signatureDishes.description: Soft chenna dumplings immersed in rich saffron-infused milk, finished with delicate pistachio and almond accents.

signatureDishes.name: Chettinad Goat Curry
signatureDishes.description: Tender goat slow-cooked in a rich Chettinad masala, layered with roasted spices and the bold flavors of Tamil Nadu.
